values.applicability: Irrigation water per tree
values.reason: No sourced value yet: reported as 'value required'
values.approved_by: Claude (AI assistant) as decision maker, delegated by the project owner; supervisor review pending
values.approval_note: Changed from null. FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) water need = ET0 x landscape coefficient. ET0 = 8.0 mm/day, mean Jun-Aug 2021-2025 of ERA5 FAO Penman-Monteith ET0 (Open-Meteo) at the sample site 30.12 N 31.85 E; landscape coefficient 0.5 (WUCOLS IV 'moderate' species factor 0.4-0.6, Costello & Jones 2014); canopy radius 3 m (interventions.tree) = 28.3 m2 -> about 110 L per tree per day in the hot season.
